run_robustmvd_evaluation: run the Fast3R model evaluation on ScanNet dataset using the rmvd framework with median alignment
create_wrapper_model: create a Fast3RWrapperModel instance to wrap Fast3R for use inside the rmvd evaluation pipeline
replace_dust3r_in_config: replace dust3r module references with fast3r.dust3r paths in a Hydra config dictionary recursively
run_input_adapter: run the input_adapter method to convert a list of numpy image arrays into DUSt3R view dictionaries
run_output_adapter: run the output_adapter method to extract depth maps and uncertainty from Fast3R model predictions
